# Lead Handoff SLA

`lead-handoff-sla` · v1.0.0 · Execute · Sales & Pipeline
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/lead-handoff-sla/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** Is sales working our MQLs within the SLA, accepting what marketing sends, and is the MQL threshold in the right place?

**Inputs:** The lead scoring model (fit criteria, behavior signals, MQL threshold), the SLA terms, and a lead export with MQL, first-touch and outcome times.

**Output:** SLA compliance, never-touched MQLs, acceptance and conversion rates with 90% ranges, a threshold check by score band, the volume-promise check, and a verdict with three fixes.

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill lead-handoff-sla`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/lead-handoff-sla/resources/handoff-sla.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/lead-handoff-sla/resources/handoff-sla.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: Claude Code, OpenAI Codex (Windows, ab-test-significance only).

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- Times are calendar hours. With businessHours on it only counts late leads that became MQLs outside Mon-Fri 09:00-17:00; it does not recompute the times.
- Rates on fewer than 30 leads are directional (AAJ's rule of thumb), and a band difference is clear only when the 90% ranges do not overlap. Do not move the threshold on a small band.
- fitMatches and signals are scored at full points with no decay. If you decay behavior points, pass the decayed number or the score bands will be wrong.
- It is only as good as the CRM timestamps. Mixed time zones or missing touch times change the rates; read the data notes before the rates.

**Review before acting:** The marketing and sales leads agree the SLA terms and which clock they use, and RevOps checks the export's time zones and outcome fields, before anyone moves the threshold or calls a lead late.
